verdict.rationale: BVNK documents a sandbox that mirrors production with test data, so developers can validate integrations without financial risk. It also provides a dedicated simulation endpoint (POST /payment/v2/payins/simulation) and describes a consistent simulation experience for pay-ins and payouts across all customer accounts. missing for 10: explicit documentation that currency conversions/Transfers v3 work in sandbox, published deterministic test values (e.g. magic amounts or addresses that trigger specific outcomes), and independent or hands-on corroboration.
